# Generated by scripts/catalog-reference.ts from the catalog compiler's tables.
# Regenerate with `node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/catalog-reference.ts --write`; never edit.

Render catalog language, schema 4

DOCUMENT  a JSON object; * marks a required key
  schema*: 4
  name*: string
  description*: string
  origin: string
  vars: object of name -> expression; Per-row variables and their defaults.
  themes: object of name -> object of name -> expression; Named sets of variable defaults, literals only.
  rules: list of rule
  layers*: list of layer

RULES  the last rule whose condition holds sets its variables
  when*: bool
  set*: object of name -> expression

LAYERS  marks drawn for each entity or relation, in order; a layer is hidden with its feature
  feature: "outlines" | "ids" | "class_names" | "score" | "confidence" | "speed" | "movement" | "attributes" | "relations"
  for: "entities" | "relations"
  when: bool
  marks*: list of mark

MARKS  {"mark": "<name>", ...}; * marks a required key
  box
    when: bool
    on: box
    w: length
    h: length
    dx: length
    dy: length
    outset: length
    min_size: length
    stroke: color
    fill: color
    width: length
    dash: bool
    radius: length
    pin: anchor; Place a w x h rect inside the reference box at this anchor.
    margin: length or list of 4 of length
  circle
    when: bool
    on: box
    dx: length
    dy: length
    min_size: length
    stroke: color
    fill: color
    width: length
    dash: bool
    r*: length
    pin: anchor; Place a w x h rect inside the reference box at this anchor.
    margin: length or list of 4 of length
  line
    when: bool
    min_size: length
    from*: point
    to*: point
    stroke: color
    width: length
    dash: bool
  arrow
    when: bool
    on: box
    min_size: length
    gain: number
    max: length
    head: length
    head_width: length
    min_speed: number
    vx: number
    vy: number
    stroke: color
    width: length
  polygon
    when: bool
    min_size: length
    stroke: color
    fill: color
    width: length
    dash: bool
  bar
    when: bool
    on: box
    w: length
    h: length
    dx: length
    dy: length
    min_size: length
    value*: number
    fill: color
    pin: anchor; Place a w x h rect inside the reference box at this anchor.
    margin: length or list of 4 of length
  text
    when: bool
    on: box
    min_size: length
    text*: text
    color*: color
    size*: length
    font: string; A font family.
    place*: list of 1 to 8 of place
  label
    when: bool
    on: box
    min_size: length
    size*: length
    background: color
    radius: length
    gap: length
    font: string; A font family.
    place*: list of 1 to 8 of place
    runs*: list of at least 1 of run
    pad: list of 2 of length; Horizontal and vertical.

PLACE  one candidate of a label or text; the first that fits is used
  when: bool
  at*: anchor
  anchor*: place_anchor
  dx: length
  dy: length

ANCHORS  points of a box
  anchor: top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center, center-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right
  place_anchor: the anchors, and "baseline" for the first line's baseline

RUN  one part of a label: text or a bar
  text: text
  bar: number
  color*: color
  weight: "regular" | "medium" | "semibold" | "bold"

TYPES  an expression has one of these types
  number: A number: 0.5, or an expression.
  bool: A condition: true, or an expression.
  string: A string expression.
  text: Text: an expression such as "trim(id, 10, 'middle')".
  color: A color: '#rrggbb', '#rrggbbaa', or an expression.
  colors: A list of colors from an attribute.
  length: A length in screen pixels: '1.5px', or an expression with box.w, box.h, box.min, image.*.
  box: A box in the image: 'box', 'source.box', 'target.box', or inset(box, 0.2).
  point: A point in the image: anchor(box, 'center').

SYNTAX
  A JSON string is an expression; a number, true, false and null stand for themselves.
  operators: || && ! == != < <= > >= ?? + - * / ( ) [ ]; `??` takes its right side when its left is missing
  membership: class in ['human', 'car']
  lengths: 1.5px is a length in screen pixels; box.w, box.h, box.min, image.w, image.h, image.min are lengths
  attributes: attr.name or attr['odd name'], typed by how they are used
  relation layers also read source.<field> and target.<field> of the two ends

FUNCTIONS
  if(condition, then, else) -> the type of the branches
  case(value, key, result, ..., default) -> the type of the results; keys are written out
  trim(text, count, where = 'end', suffix = '…', delimiter = '') -> text; where is 'end' or 'middle'
  fixed(number, digits) -> text; digits is a whole number from 0 to 100, written out
  min(a, b) -> number or length
  max(a, b) -> number or length
  clamp(value, low, high) -> number or length
  alpha(color, opacity) -> color
  ramp(value, stop, color, stop, color, ...) -> color; at least two pairs, stops written out and rising
  palette(key, [color, ...]) -> color; the same key gives the same color
  top(colors) -> color; the highest-scoring color of an attribute
  inset(box, fraction) -> box; fraction is 0 to 0.5
  anchor(box, 'name') -> point; name is one of the anchors below, written out

FIELDS  what an expression reads of the row; relation layers also read relation
  id: string
  class: string
  score: number
  confidence: number
  motion_state: string
  velocity.x: number
  velocity.y: number
  box: box
  box.w: length
  box.h: length
  box.min: length
  image.w: length
  image.h: length
  image.min: length
  relation: string (relation layers only)

LIMITS
  expression length: 4096 characters
  expression depth: 64
  expression parts: 1024
